about:
Creative Packaging Company is headquartered in Shelbyville, Kentucky, just outside Louisville. The business has operated for over three decades as a privately held, family-run enterprise. While no founding year is published, the company describes its history as spanning more than thirty years of providing custom-designed packaging solutions.

The company manufactures expanded polystyrene (EPS) products, gel packs, and liners, including its signature BioDrain environmentally safe disposal gel pack. Operations center on a 140,000-square-foot manufacturing facility on 26 acres in Shelbyville, supplemented by five to seven additional plants across the United States. The workforce numbers around 300 employees, serving roughly 300 customers nationwide. Capabilities include custom EPS molding, gel pack production, cold chain management programs, temperature and material testing, and environmental consulting for packaging.

Primary markets include meal kit delivery services, pharmaceutical and life sciences distribution, protective packaging, construction, and other temperature-sensitive distribution sectors. The firm works directly with manufacturers and distributors in those industries, providing both standard and custom-engineered packaging systems.

Creative Packaging emphasizes its family-owned structure and ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system as differentiators. The national footprint of multiple manufacturing sites is positioned to support rapid, reliable cold chain logistics, while the BioDrain product addresses environmental disposal concerns. The company states it forms partnerships with customers to deliver cost-effective, high-performance packaging solutions.
